finding: The Harness detected parameter drift. The parameter used in the actual invocation differed from the human-approved parameter.
evidence: The target system accepted the actual invocation.
Fresh target-state verification confirmed the attempted parameter value.
why_it_matters: Successful execution does not establish approval-to-action integrity. The executed parameters must also match the parameters that were approved.
scope: Controlled validation of the tested mechanism in a reference environment. Production-wide effectiveness was not evaluated.
